name: TR707 brush kit ghosts
desc: Harvested TR707 jazz kit: ghost-note gain patterns on hats and snare, rim accents, phrase-end double-time fills, slow hat-filter drift.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.7).lpf(2200), s("[hh ~] hh [~ hh] hh").bank("RolandTR707").gain(".38 .18 .26 .15").lpf(sine.range(2200,3200).slow(32)).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(16))).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.8).lpf(2400), s("~ sd ~ [sd ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(".5 .28 .42 .24").lpf(2600), s("[hh oh] hh [hh ~] hh").bank("RolandTR707").gain(".5 .25 .35 .2 .45 .25 .3 .2").lpf(sine.range(2600,3600).slow(32)).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("~ ~ [~ rim] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.36)).fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR707").gain(".82 .45 .6 .4 .76 .48 .64 .42").lpf(2800), s("[hh oh] [hh hh] [oh hh] [hh ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.28, ${gain}*.62).fast(2)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(12)), s("rim(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.38).delay(.25).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25), s("~ ~ ~ [~ cp]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.34).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
